description: Convert a screenshot, mockup, or wireframe image into framework-specific component code. Supports React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and HTML. Optionally uses shadcn/ui, Radix, Headless UI, PrimeVue, or Material UI.

component_library.description: Component library to use in generated code

component_name.description: Optional name for the generated component (auto-detected if omitted)

description.description: Optional textual description of the UI in the image to guide code generation (e.g., "A pricing page with 3 tiers and a toggle for monthly/annual billing")

image_data.description: Base64-encoded image data of the screenshot, mockup, or wireframe to convert into a component

name: image_to_component
